headline: Cautiously optimistic amid rate-hike cycle

highlights: Key Points  Sundaram Finance’s 2QFY27 results beat total income and PPOP consensus estimates by 6.2% and 3.8%, respectively, while PAT lagged the estimate by 2.8% due to higher provisioning.  AUM rose 19% YoY to Rs659.9bn and disbursements rose 28% to Rs103.6bn.

NII rose 17% YoY to Rs9.63bn and PAT rose 21% to Rs4.75bn, though profit from operations grew at a slower 11% to Rs5.57bn.  We value SUF’s standalone business using our RI-based fair value framework to derive a fair value and arrive at a TP of Rs4,610 (previously Rs4,650); we maintain our HOLD rating on the stock.
Growth was backed by a wider network, with branches rising to 811 (728).
NII rose 17% YoY to Rs9.63bn and profit from operations rose 11% to Rs5.57bn, while PAT rose 20.5% to Rs4.75bn (Rs3.94bn).
